title: Main memory
body:
## RAM
* Random Access Memory
* Used for storing data that the [[CPU]] needs to access quickly.

## ROM
* Read-Only Memory
[[Cache]]

One memory for both code and data, because the 68000 is a [[VonNeumann]] machine. It is
slower than the [[CPU]], which is the entire reason for [[Cache]] and for the memory
hierarchy. Reached over the address and data halves of the [[Bus]].
